mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 10.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO > 102.0), supply expansion supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO > 102.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales series (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which consistently drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
